Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculat.title: Corrected lower-clamped square moment: where the coefficient comes from

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculat.type:
LeanMirror.Expr.eval Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculations.model
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculations.lowerSquare.goal () ↔
  ∀ (r : ℝ),
    Verification.quadraticF (r ^ 2) 1 - Verification.quadraticF (r ^ 2) r =
      1 / 5 - 2 * r ^ 2 / 3 + r ^ 4 - 8 * r ^ 5 / 15

∀ (q t : ℝ),
  LeanMirror.Expr.eval Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculations.model
      Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.ArticleCalculations.primitiveDefinition (t, q, ()) =
    Verification.quadraticF q t

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blest_condition.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu C =
    (12 * ∫ (v : ↑unitInterval) (u : ↑unitInterval), (1 - ↑u) ^ 2 * C.conditionalCDF u v) - 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.exact_region.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  (x, y) ∈ Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.attainableRegion ↔
    x = 1 ∧ |y| ≤ 1 ∨ ∃ b, 0 ≤ b ∧ x = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula b ∧ |y| ≤ Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula b

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremal_cdf.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).cdf ![u, v] =
    ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval) in Set.Iic u,
      Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑t) ^ 2 - Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalQ b hb v))

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremal_coeffi.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b hb).chatterjeeXi = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula b ∧
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b hb) =
      Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula b

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 < b),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).chatterjeeXi =
      (183 * √((b - 1) / b) - 38 * b * √((b - 1) / b) - 88 * b ^ 2 * √((b - 1) / b) + 112 * b ^ 2 +
              48 * b ^ 3 * √((b - 1) / b) -
            48 * b ^ 3 -
          105 * Real.arcosh √b / b) /
        210 ∧
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯) =
      (87 * √((b - 1) / b) / b + 250 * √((b - 1) / b) - 376 * b * √((b - 1) / b) + 448 * b +
              144 * b ^ 2 * √((b - 1) / b) -
            144 * b ^ 2 -
          105 * Real.arcosh √b / b ^ 2) /
        420

∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Icc 0 1),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).chatterjeeXi = 8 * b ^ 2 * (7 - 3 * b) / 105 ∧
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯) = 4 * b * (28 - 9 * b) / 105

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremal_condit.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (v : ↑unitInterval),
  (fun u => (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).conditionalCDF u v) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume]
    fun u => Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑u) ^ 2 - Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalQ b hb v))

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremal_normal.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
      ∃! q, q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 ∧ ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval), Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑t) ^ 2 - q)) = ↑v

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.formula_derivat.type: ∀ (b : ℝ), 0 < b → deriv Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula b = deriv Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula b / b

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.formula_hasDeri.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    HasDerivAt Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula (b * Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.boundaryDerivative b) b ∧
      HasDerivAt Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.boundaryDerivative b) b

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.formula_infinit.type:
Filter.Tendsto Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.lower_boundary_.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b),
  C.chatterjeeXi = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula b →
    (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu C = -Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula b ↔
      C = (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).reflect {1})

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.lower_square_po.type:
∀ (r : ℝ),
  Verification.quadraticF (r ^ 2) 1 - Verification.quadraticF (r ^ 2) r = 1 / 5 - 2 * r ^ 2 / 3 + r ^ 4 - 8 * r ^ 5 / 15

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMe.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      HasDerivAt (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b)
        (-b * (Verification.quadraticUpper b q - Verification.quadraticLower q)) q

∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    Continuous (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) ∧
      StrictAntiOn (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) (Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1) ∧
        Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b (-1 / b) = 1 ∧
          Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b 1 = 0 ∧
            ∀ (q : ℝ), Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b q ∈ Set.Icc 0 1

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalization_s.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (G : ℝ → ℝ),
  Continuous G →
    ∫ (v : ↑unitInterval), G (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalQ b hb v) =
      ∫ (q : ℝ) in -1 / b..1, G q * -deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.one_dimensional.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯).chatterjeeXi =
      (6 *
          ∫ (q : ℝ) in -1 / b..1,
            Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.sectionSquare b q * -deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q) -
        2 ∧
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯) =
      (12 *
          ∫ (q : ℝ) in -1 / b..1,
            Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.sectionWeighted b q * -deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q) -
        2

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.relaxed_distanc.type:
∀ (h : ↑unitInterval × ↑unitInterval → ℝ),
  Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.AdmissibleKernel h →
    ∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b),
      6 * ∫ (p : ↑unitInterval × ↑unitInterval), (h p - Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel b hb p) ^ 2 ≤
        Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelXi h -
            Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelXi (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel b hb) -
          b *
            (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu h -
              Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel b hb))

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.relaxed_solutio.type:
∀ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1,
  ∃! b,
    Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelXi (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel ↑b ⋯) = c ∧
      ∀ (h : ↑unitInterval × ↑unitInterval → ℝ),
        Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.AdmissibleKernel h →
          Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelXi h ≤ c →
            Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu h ≤
                Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel ↑b ⋯) ∧
              (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu h =
                  Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.kernelNu (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel ↑b ⋯) ↔
                h =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume] Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalKernel ↑b ⋯)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.section_formula.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      have r := Verification.quadraticLower q;
      have s := Verification.quadraticUpper b q;
      ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval), Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑t) ^ 2 - q)) =
          1 - s + b * (Verification.quadraticT q s - Verification.quadraticT q r) ∧
        ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval), Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑t) ^ 2 - q)) ^ 2 =
            1 - s + b ^ 2 * (Verification.quadraticF q s - Verification.quadraticF q r) ∧
          ∫ (t : ↑unitInterval), (1 - ↑t) ^ 2 * Verification.unitClamp (b * ((1 - ↑t) ^ 2 - q)) =
            (1 - s ^ 3) / 3 + b * (Verification.quadraticS q s - Verification.quadraticS q r)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.shuffledCopula_.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.IsSI →
    ∀ (p q : ↑unitInterval),
      q ≤ p → (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.shuffledCopula C p).ConcordanceLE (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.shuffledCopula C q)

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    ∃ δ,
      0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (p q : ↑unitInterval),
          |↑p - ↑q| < δ →
            ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval),
              |(Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.shuffledCopula C p).cdf x -
                    (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.shuffledCopula C q).cdf x| <
                ε

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.substitution_do.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      0 ≤ q →
        √(q + 1 / b) ≤ 1 →
          -(2 * √(q + 1 / b)) * deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q = 1 + b * (√(q + 1 / b) - √q) ^ 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.substitution_lo.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      0 ≤ q →
        1 ≤ √(q + 1 / b) → -(2 * √q) * deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q = 2 * b * √q * (1 - √q)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.substitution_un.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      q ≤ 0 →
        1 ≤ √(q + 1 / b) →
          -(2 * √(q + 1 / b)) * deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q = 2 * b * √(q + 1 / b)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.substitution_up.type:
∀ (b q : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    q ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / b) 1 →
      q ≤ 0 →
        √(q + 1 / b) ≤ 1 →
          -(2 * √(q + 1 / b)) * deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.normalizationMean b) q = 2 * b * √(q + 1 / b) ^ 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.upper_boundary_.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b),
  C.chatterjeeXi = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xiFormula b →
    (Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.blestNu C = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.nuFormula b ↔
      C = Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.extremalCopula b ⋯)

Papers.Rockel2026XiBlest.xi_mixture_cont.type: ∀ (C D : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2), Continuous fun a => (C.mix D a).chatterjeeXi
